blurb: Bragging Rights is the largest arcade in North Central Florida featuring hundreds of classic and modern arcade games, pinball, and carnival games all set for unlimited play with one low price. Guests can enjoy food and drinks from a large menu and book parties for birthdays, corporate events, fundraisers, and more. The venue hosts regular events including comedy nights, karaoke, date nights, and industry nights.
extraNote: Booking deposit for parties is non-refundable but party can be rescheduled · No outside food or drinks allowed except desserts for birthdays; $50 fee to bring own food excluding drinks · At the arcade location, 105 NW 8th Ave, Gainesville, FL
